snippet.title: What Lurks Inside - Indie Survival Horror Teaser #blacktides
snippet.description:
In the rot of the Ormora... our first look at the man inside. The walls are breathing... and they are hungry.

Welcome to our first official look at Black Tides, a new third-person survival horror game built in Unreal Engine 5. In this video, we're diving into the atmospheric horror, environmental design, and mechanics behind our upcoming title. Much more to come soon!

#IndieDev #SurvivalHorror #Gamedev #indie horror game #thirdperson #atmospherichorror
